title: Avondale Arts Alliance

services.name: Winter Exhibition
services.desc: We are inviting our artists who participated in the Plein Air Painting event in late October to display their works in a mini exhibition in the Little Gallery. Open hours: Saturday morning 11am-2pm, Saturday evening 4-7pm, Sunday morning 11am-2pm. Closing reception: Monday, December 1 from 6-8pm during the Christmas Tree Lighting at the Town Green next door. Visitors are invited to VOTE on their favorite pieces during open hours over the weekend. There will be prizes offered for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners, plus a bonus Kid’s Award for artists under 18 years old.
